newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down eight cents on London's fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down eight cents on London's fall.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down eight cents at 14.56 ringgit ($5.84) a kg, pressured by a $30 drop on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight and a larger offering at the opening, traders said.
There were initial offers for 101 tonnes against bids for only three tonnes. "Buyers only appeared at the lower levels," said one trader.
Final turnover was 91 tonnes, against 82 on Monday, with buying again coming from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
The local price premium over the LME narrowed to $15 a tonne from $25 previously. ($1=2.4920 ringgit)
